summary.text: Brad Overcash is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 43 since January 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is an attorney in private practice.

paragraphs.text: Brad Overcash lives in Belmont, North Carolina, according to Ballotpedia.

He earned a B.A. in political science from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and a J.D. from the University of Mississippi, and his career experience includes working as an attorney in private practice.
Overcash was vice chairman of the Gaston County Republican Party, chairman of the 10th Congressional District Republican Party and treasurer of the North Carolina Republican Party.
He also served on the Gaston County Family Advisory Board and as chairman of the Gaston College Board of Trustees.
He assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Kathy Harrington.
